SELECT COUNT(*) total, SUM(prc IS NOT NULL) has_prc, SUM(prc_usd IS NOT NULL) has_usd,
 SUM(prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NULL) prc_only,
 SUM(prc_usd IS NOT NULL AND prc IS NULL) usd_only,
 SUM(ABS(prc/100.0 - prc_usd) > 0.001) mismatch
FROM items_g2

SELECT COUNT(*) n,
 SUM(CASE WHEN rtg=1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) one_star
FROM fdbk_g2 f JOIN items_g2 i ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id
WHERE LENGTH(f.body) > 500 AND i.prc_usd <= 40

SELECT COUNT(*) n,
 SUM(CASE WHEN rtg=1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) one_star
FROM fdbk_g2 f JOIN items_g2 i ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id
WHERE LENGTH(f.body) > 500 AND i.prc <= 4000

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.rtg=1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_1star,
 COUNT(*) AS n,
 SUM(f.rtg=1.0) AS one_star
FROM fdbk_g2 f JOIN items_g2 i ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id
WHERE LENGTH(f.body) > 500 AND i.prc_usd <= 40
SELECT COUNT(*) all_rev, SUM(LENGTH(body)>500) body_gt500, SUM(body IS NULL) null_body FROM fdbk_g2
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fdbk_g2 f LEFT JOIN items_g2 i ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id WHERE i.ref_id IS NULL
